strategy.name: official-source-confirmation
strategy.description: Confirm the official INSS update and record source, date, validity and manual approval.

strategy.name: structured-rule-update
strategy.description: Update only the governed structured source in a controlled real execution phase.

strategy.name: projection-check
strategy.description: Run scripts/transform-rules.js to verify aggregate equivalence and expected transformed output.

strategy.name: runtime-aggregate-update
strategy.description: Update data/tabelas-trabalhistas.json only after approval gates pass.

strategy.name: calculator-impact-tests
strategy.description: Run direct calculator tests for INSS, salary, 13th salary, vacation, CLT vs PJ, autonomous and MEI calculators.

strategy.name: content-review-queue
strategy.description: Queue affected articles for controlled review without automatic mutation.

strategy.name: approval-and-publication
strategy.description: Publish only after Testing, Validation, rollback and manual approval gates pass.

creditEconomy: The dependency maps limit review to affected assets instead of scanning the whole repository repeatedly.
The transformer provides a deterministic comparison between source and runtime aggregate.
Content changes remain queued as typed review tasks instead of being guessed automatically.
